mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.workspace_id,e.project_id,e.query,e.expected_answer,e.recall,e.citation,e.json_score,e.status,e.updated_at FROM evaluation_cases e JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id=e.workspace_id AND wm.user_id=#{userId} AND wm.status='ACTIVE' WHERE e.workspace_id=#{workspaceId} ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC
